description: This file defines a custom Android View called QiblaCompassView that renders a compass UI element indicating the Qibla direction relative to the device's orientation. It includes drawing the compass ring, tick marks, labels, and arrows for Qibla direction and North reference, with smooth animations when orientation changes.

classes.name: QiblaCompassView
classes.description: A custom Android view that displays a compass indicating Qibla direction with animated transitions and static North marker.

methods.name: setQiblaBearingDegrees
methods.description: Updates the Qibla bearing in degrees and triggers a smooth animation to the new direction.

methods.name: setDeviceAzimuthDegrees
methods.description: Updates the device's azimuth in degrees and triggers a smooth animation for the compass.

methods.name: invalidateSmooth
methods.description: Calculates the relative bearing and initiates an animated transition.

methods.name: animateTo
methods.description: Animates the compass arrow to a target angle with smooth rotation handling.

methods.name: onDraw
methods.description: Overrides View's onDraw to render the compass UI, including ring, tick marks, labels, and directional arrows.

methods.name: drawArrow
methods.description: Draws an arrow pointing in a specified direction at the given length and center point.

methods.name: normalize
methods.description: Normalizes an angle to the 0-360 degree range.

methods.name: shortestDelta
methods.description: Calculates the shortest angle difference between two angles, considering wrap-around at 360 degrees.
